REV L4 per axle (Y-): 45T 120-2 split rim ring bolted to a Ø150 pressed flanged hub
(no key, SHRINK 0.15-0.20), 54-link chain C417.6 to a 15T
on MS05 shaft code 5 W55x3x17; motor on PL25 slotted bracket under transom

Removed: Dodge TA7315H15MS, H1B110, belt drop, TA rod.
AWAIT: Poclain AE (radial/offset, spline); chain/sprocket maker.
Inside axleboxes AWAIT bearing; primary springs AWAIT (LT35).
Anti-slip (L4.1): NO flow divider - PLUS+1 traction control, pony 3rd pickup, sand.
L4.2: LOW TRACTION PIN Ø120 4140 + GE120ES housing under transom at Z650
(X4075/7275, calc L42-tp); centre plate flat-lined (vertical only). Bump stops ±22.
L4.2: sanders on BOTH trucks (level + flow proof, hill-hold); flange withdraw 28,
re-profile <= 27 (all wheels); P-103-1 hanger L-weld + 2 PL16 gussets (Loco Bot L-103).
